TABLE.NAME: local_feedback_submissions
TABLE.COMMENT: Student feedback submitted about a course via the floating feedback widget

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 when the submitter chose to remain anonymous

FIELD.NAME: sentiment
FIELD.COMMENT: happy, neutral or sad

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: An admin-configured area label, or free text from the "Other" option - optional, null if the submitter skipped this step

FIELD.NAME: breadcrumb
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle's own breadcrumb trail at submission time, e.g. Course > Grades > User report

FIELD.NAME: campaignid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 for submissions predating campaigns, or where the matched campaign expired between page load and submit

FIELD.NAME: campaignname
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised snapshot of the campaign's name at submission time, so reports survive the campaign being renamed or deleted

TABLE.NAME: local_feedback_campaigns
TABLE.COMMENT: Admin-configured feedback campaigns: scoped targeting and scheduling for the floating feedback widget

FIELD.NAME: modaltitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Overrides the widget modal's title for this campaign; empty falls back to the site-wide default (the modaltitle language string)

FIELD.NAME: introtext
FIELD.COMMENT: Short intro shown before the sentiment picker, explaining this campaign to the submitter; empty shows nothing

FIELD.NAME: priority
FIELD.COMMENT: Lower value takes precedence when more than one campaign matches the same page/user

FIELD.NAME: starttime
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = no lower bound

FIELD.NAME: endtime
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = no upper bound

FIELD.NAME: topics
FIELD.COMMENT: Newline list of this campaign's own feedback topic labels; empty = fall back to the site-wide local_feedback/categories setting

FIELD.NAME: skiptopicstep
FIELD.COMMENT: Skip the topic/area step entirely, going straight from the sentiment buttons to the comment box

FIELD.NAME: labelhappy
FIELD.COMMENT: Overrides the text shown under the happy sentiment face for this campaign; empty falls back to the sentiment_happy language string

FIELD.NAME: labelneutral
FIELD.COMMENT: Overrides the text shown under the neutral sentiment face for this campaign; empty falls back to the sentiment_neutral language string

FIELD.NAME: labelsad
FIELD.COMMENT: Overrides the text shown under the sad sentiment face for this campaign; empty falls back to the sentiment_sad language string

FIELD.NAME: coursefocused
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this campaign's report compares courses/categories and is linked from matching courses' own Reports menus (1), or gets a flat course-less dashboard and no course nav link (0)

FIELD.NAME: responselimit
FIELD.COMMENT: How often the same user may submit to this campaign: none, daily (once per calendar day) or once (once ever)

FIELD.NAME: maxresponses
FIELD.COMMENT: Once this many total responses have been collected the campaign stops matching for anyone; 0 = no limit

FIELD.NAME: categoryids
FIELD.COMMENT: Newline list of Moodle course category ids to target (matches descendants too); empty = all categories

FIELD.NAME: pagetypepatterns
FIELD.COMMENT: Newline list of $PAGE->pagetype patterns, * wildcard supported; empty = all pages

FIELD.NAME: targetroles
FIELD.COMMENT: CSV of role shortnames; empty = no role restriction

FIELD.NAME: targetcohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = no cohort restriction

FIELD.NAME: targetuserids
FIELD.COMMENT: Newline list of user ids; empty = no restriction

TABLE.NAME: local_feedback_campaign_responses
TABLE.COMMENT: Enforces a campaign's response limit: one row per submission attempt that was actually recorded, keyed by the real user id even when that submission itself was anonymous - never exposed in reports, purely an internal rate-limit ledger

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course this response was made under; only used to scope the limit per-course for a course-focused campaign, ignored otherwise
